verdict.rationale: Convex documents third-party auth integrations (Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit, Auth0, Convex Auth) but provides no evidence of enforcing MFA or built-in enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) itself as a platform-level control; it defers entirely to external providers. missing for 10: any documentation of Convex enforcing MFA policy, native SAML/OIDC SSO support, or admin controls to require these for application users.
